Canoe.headline: One trip, one budget, paid on-chain.
Canoe.intro: Lock NEAR for a trip, split it into flight, hotel and car limits, and approve each payment from your own wallet. The contract refuses any payment over a limit.
Canoe.simulated: Booking with the airline, hotel or rental company is simulated. The NEAR transfer to the merchant account is real on testnet.
Canoe.scale: Testnet demo scale: quotes are {percent}% of the real price.
Canoe.noOffers: No tracked offers with a price yet. Track a flight, hotel or car first.
Canoe.connectFirst: Connect a wallet to create a budget and pay.
